notes: The subject publishes one adapter-configured ordinary interaction class, then unpublishes it through IEEE 1516.1-2025. A fresh IEEE 1516.2-2025 HLArequestPublications query must return the HLAreportInteractionPublication NULL response with exactly one HLAinteractionClassList parameter whose encoded list is empty. The ordinary object-class publication is checked unchanged. The directed-interaction report is validated against its MIM-defined NULL or populated parameter shape, without asserting an additional side effect between the two publication services.

requirements.statement: The federate withdraws its ordinary publication of the selected interaction class through the standard Unpublish Interaction Class service. A later publication query reflects the changed interaction-class declaration.

When the queried federate publishes no ordinary interaction classes, the MIM requires one NULL publication report with the HLAinteractionClassList parameter present and containing an empty list. The test also verifies the unchanged object-class publication and validates the directed-interaction report using the MIM-defined shape corresponding to its reported count, without imposing a separate cross-service declaration rule.
